Jio Relaunches Prime Membership with One-Year Price Guarantee

Reliance Jio has relaunched its Jio Prime membership program, offering a one-year price guarantee on recharges for its over 500 million users. The revived plan aims to protect subscribers from tariff hikes for a year. Specific details mention a ₹299 plan and cashback vouchers for select device setups. The move follows Airtel's reduction of its cheaper plans.
